title: Topological Order
statement:
Use indegrees and a min-heap to produce the lexicographically smallest topological order of a directed graph.

Input
n m followed by m directed edges u v requiring u before v.

Output
Print the order, or IMPOSSIBLE if no valid order exists.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 200000, 0 ≤ m ≤ 200000. Endpoints are in [1,n]. Parallel edges and self-loops are allowed.
